items.headline: Italy: doosre din bhi farzi bomb dhamki
items.detail: Italy me guruvaar ko bhi 3,778 schoolon ko email se farzi bomb dhamki mili — budhwar ko 6,300 school prabhavit hue the; sirf 77 school khaali karaye gaye, kahin visfotak nahi mila; sarkar ne naya protocol jaari kiya.
items.exam_angle: Europe me hybrid warfare aur cyber-suraksha — antarrashtriya suraksha ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Putin: samjhauta nahi, ek sheher me yuddh-viram
items.detail: Putin ne Moscow me America ke dooton Kushner aur Witkoff se milkar kaha — Ukraine par apni kattar maangein nahi chhodega, lekin Kostyantynivka sheher me chhota yuddh-viram aur manaviy mission ka prastav diya; videshi shanti-sena ko ‘yuddh jaari rakhna’ bataya, doot ab Dublin me Zelensky se milenge.
items.exam_angle: Russia-Ukraine shanti vaarta aur Europe ki suraksha vyavastha — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Fujairah: truck hadse me 14 ki maut
items.detail: UAE ke Fujairah me budh raat truck bekabu hokar kayi gaadiyon se takraya aur aag lag gayi — 18 car aur 5 truck shamil, 14 ki maut aur 30 ghayal hue; ghayalon me Bharat ke nagrik bhi hain.
items.exam_angle: UAE me sadak suraksha aur pravasi Bharatiya — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Brooklyn imarat dhahi: 8 ki maut
items.detail: New York ke Brooklyn me budhvaar shaam teen-manzila imarat paas ke nirman sthal par gir gayi — 8 ki maut, jinme 2 bachche aur 2 mazdoor shamil, 18 ghayal; shahar ke vibhag ne kaha paas ki khudai me 'asurakshit nirman kaam' kaaran bana; mayor ne 100 se zyada nirman sthalon ki jaanch ke aadesh diye.

items.headline: Saudi: EU Houthi ko aatanki ghoshit kare
items.detail: Saudi Arabia EU par dabaav daal raha hai ki Yemen ke Iran-samarthit Houthi sangathan ko aatanki sangathan ghoshit kare — Houthi ke Saudi par lagbhag roz ke hamle jaari hain; chhah European adhikariyon ke mutabik zyadaatar sadasya desh hichkicha rahe hain, kyunki isse Yemen shanti vaarta ke raaste band ho sakte hain; faisle ke liye 27 sadasya deshon ki sarvasammati chahiye.
items.exam_angle: Yemen sangharsh, EU ki videsh neeti aur aatankwad-suchi — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Washington gym firing: 2 ki maut, 4 ghayal
items.detail: Washington DC ke Logan Circle me guruvaar subah VIDA Fitness gym me ek doctor ne firing ki — building manager James Stuart ki maut, 4 log ghayal hue, ek ki haalat gambhir; hamlaawar ne saatvin manzil ke penthouse se bhi goliyan chalaai aur baad me khud ko goli maar li; police ke mutabik building ke kaale phaphundi (black mold) vivaad se jhagra tha.

items.headline: Hormuz: ab kul 4 tanker dhamakon ki chapet me
items.detail: Hormuz Strait me budhwar raat 2 supertanker dhamakon ke baad band ho gaye; guruvaar dopahar ko 2 aur tanker ne surang (mine) se takkar khaai — kul 4 tanker dhamakon ki chapet me aaye; Iran ki sena ke mutabik sabhi ne chetavni nazarandaaz ki thi aur 'bina anumati' wale raste par the; Reuters ke mutabik Iran ke daave ki swatantra pushti abhi nahi hui hai.
items.exam_angle: Hormuz Strait duniya ke tel vyapar ka sabse mahatvapurna rasta hai — energy suraksha ke liye ahem.
